heroSubtitle: From middle school to college, Winchester Kiwanis invests in young leaders - giving students the skills, community, and purpose to make a real difference.
introTitle: Building the Next Generation of Servant Leaders
introBody1: The Kiwanis family of youth clubs gives young people at every stage of their education the tools, experiences, and community to become confident leaders committed to service. Winchester's current public focus includes Key Club, Builder's Club, Circle K, and scholarships.
introBody2: Whether they're packing food bags alongside adult Kiwanis members, leading their own school projects, or organizing service events that impact thousands - Winchester's young people are making a real difference right now.
introImageAlt: Young students engaged in a Kiwanis-sponsored leadership activity
